items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 12:1
items.html: (To the question) Four including aspects are discerned in every Partzuf, and they are: Ibur, Yenika, Mochin, and Keter. (Item 7).
